description: This file defines the LinkDialog class for managing link insertion dialogs in the Summernote WYSIWYG editor, including UI setup, event handling, and dialog control.

classes.name: LinkDialog
classes.description: Class managing the link insertion dialog in Summernote editor, including UI rendering, event binding, and dialog interactions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the LinkDialog with the given editor context, setting up UI references and language options.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Creates and renders the link dialog UI, attaching it to the DOM.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the dialog from the DOM and hides it.

methods.name: bindEnterKey
methods.description: Binds the Enter key event to trigger the link insertion button.

methods.name: toggleLinkBtn
methods.description: Enables or disables the insert link button based on input values.

methods.name: showLinkDialog
methods.description: Displays the dialog, sets up event handlers for user input, and returns a promise resolving with link info.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Triggers the process to get link info and display the dialog for user interaction.
